{{Quote|Generis has been destroyed by the Yuuzhan Vong.|[[Droma]]|<ref name="Reunion" />}}
Around the end of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] between the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the Yuuzhan Vong '''attacked''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Generis/Legends|Generis]]. The Yuuzhan Vong destroyed the [[Outer Rim Communications Center]] on the planet before fleeing from an [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].
